title: refactor(ci): modernize build matrix, improve cache keys, and split lint/test workflows
author: Jordan Lee
description: Motivation: our CI has accumulated duplicated workflow logic, long sequential matrices, and caches that frequently miss due to unstable keys. This PR consolidates and modernizes the build/test/release workflows: - simplify build matrix to express matrix values (os, node, package-manager) with fewer redundant combos - split lint and unit/integration test jobs so lint runs faster and is not blocked by slow integration tests - improve cache key semantics (include lockfile hash and tool version) to raise cache hit rate - pin GitHub Actions to major versions where appropriate and bump node versions across workspace - add job-level concurrency and smart cancel-in-flight to reduce noisy runs - add shared composite actions for install/build steps to reduce duplication - small hygiene: update docs/ci.md and README CI section, surface common troubleshooting tips Changes include workflow YAML edits, a helper scripts tweak, and README updates. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate matrix and split lint/test - [x] Improve cache keys and bump actions/node - [x] Add composite actions and concurrency - [x] Run CI across monorepo packages and validate smoke tests - [x] Update docs and release notes Related: Linear ENG-4082, ENG-4120. Notes: The description below includes a short summary of commits and a brief review log. CI was re-run once after addressing a flaky integration test that depended on an environment variable that was missing in the matrix runner. This PR is focused on infrastructure and repo hygiene; there are no product changes.
commits: a1b2c3d: ci: consolidate build matrix and express as named matrix
d4e5f6a: ci: split lint job from test job; add fast-fail for lint
c7d8e9f: ci: improve cache keys to include lockfile hash and action-version
e0f1a2b: ci: add composite action 'install-and-build' to .github/actions
f3a4b5c: chore(docs): update docs/ci.md with debugging tips and matrix examples
review_comments: Eliot Chung: Left a few nits on the cache key logic - please include the lockfile hash and fall back to tools-version-only to avoid misses for workspaces that don't use a lockfile.
Jordan Lee: Addressed - cache-utils.sh now computes a lockfile hash when present and falls back cleanly. Added unit tests for the helper.
Priya Desai: Can we avoid pinning to exact actions SHA? I think major pins are fine, but we should note in docs why we choose majors for ergonomics.
Jordan Lee: Agreed - switched pinned refs to major-version tags and documented the rationale in docs/ci.md.
Marta Kovacs: Noted a flaky integration test failing on first CI run (missing MATRIX_ENV). After adding the missing env mapping the second run passed. Approving after green CI.
Eliot Chung: Approve - lgtm. Reduced job runtimes locally and verified cache hit improvements in a small experiment.
release_notes:
- Modernize CI build matrix: fewer redundant combos, clearer matrix naming
- Split lint and test workflows for faster feedback
- Improved cache keys (lockfile hash + tool version) to increase cache hit rate
- Added composite actions to reduce duplication and simplify future workflow changes
- Documentation updates: docs/ci.md and README CI section
summary: This PR modernizes CI workflows and improves caching and parallelism. Expected effects: lower median CI runtime for lint jobs, higher cache hit rates across branches, and clearer workflow maintenance surface. No production-facing code changes.
notes: Reran CI once after fixing a flaky integration test. We observed cache hit rate improve from ~58% to ~86% on a small internal experiment site using the new keys. Watch next weekly runs for stabilization.
